name: superharness
description: Project-level autonomous engineering harness: TDD-first workflow, systematic debugging, planning and verification skills. Invoke /superharness:go <goal> for end-to-end tasks, /superharness:light <goal> for small focused changes, /superharness:brainstorm <topic> for a live mind map, and /superharness:onboarding to analyze the codebase's business logic for newcomer onboarding.
